info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to kill, to cause pain, to torment, to irritate

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' lumbayed tumbayedarde Sapi lumbati tumbati ' (Slo. 139) iti devaH . kzIrataraNgiRyAm ' ardane ' ityuktam . devamEtreyO ' ardane ' ityeva paWataH . ' curAdipAWAdeva iditkaraRAt lumbayati - lumbati iti sidDeH ardanerTe BvAdO pAWosya vyarTaH syAt . iha (curAdO) adarSanarTe tu arTaBedAt sopi (BvAdO pAWa:) sArTakaH syAt . ata eva ' adarSane ' ityeva samaYjasamiti BAti ' iti kfdantarUpamAlA .
